name: emoji-spree-choice-chips
title: Emoji Spree Choice Chips
description: Three draggable rows of rounded interest chips, each with an emoji and a label. Picking one lights it up, floats a huge copy of its emoji upward, and a pill at the bottom counts how many you have chosen.
use: An onboarding or profile step asks people to pick several interests and wants the choice to feel fun and tactile.
avoid: The giant emoji burst and draggable rows are playful and heavy for a serious form or a tight mobile card.
a11y: Chips are buttons with their emoji and label, but selection is shown only by colour with no aria-pressed, and there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark stage headed Interests holds three rows of rounded chips, each with a small emoji and a label on a dark pill with a thin border; selected chips turn lighter. A big emoji floats up the centre when picked, and a rounded counter pill sits at the bottom edge.
behaves: Clicking a chip toggles it and, on a new pick, spawns three large copies of its emoji that rise, grow and fade over a second. The rows can be dragged sideways, selected chips stay highlighted, and the bottom pill updates to the number chosen.
customise: Pass interests as an array of id, label and emoji, and an onChange callback reports the selected ids. Colours, drag behaviour and particle size are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A grid of chips with a few motion particles spawned per pick.
demo: Interest chips for Coffee, Hiking, Live music, Cooking, Gaming, Plants, Photography, Space and more.
issues: Selection is shown only by a slight lightness change, which is easy to miss on the dark stage.
With a single pick the counter pill reads '1 Interests', which is ungrammatical.
The large floating emoji covers several chips while it rises.
polishWhy: Playful emoji burst, but the singular count reads '1 Interests' and selection is easy to miss.
